summary: The new emergency deny-list fallback is soundly fail-closed: product/canon writes stay denied when factory_lib/state is unparseable, git-native recovery is whitelisted to exactly the git ls-files -u unmerged paths, and command chaining is neutralized because every non-flag arg must be a subset of the unmerged set. No trust-boundary or injection findings.
residual_risks: _fallback_readonly and _git_recovery parse commands textually; if a future shell-feature (e.g. process substitution) is added to the allow path it must be re-audited, but current rejects on $ ` <> and non-unmerged path args hold.
